accepted_scope: All complete characteristic-zero non-Archimedean fields, arbitrary-dimensional smooth geometrically integral projective varieties and actual ample rational bundles: completed-algebraic-closure quotient, actual all-point singular PSH and extended-energy/E1 descent, unique invariant Radon lift, continuous-test dual equality, and genuine continuous mixed-operator covariance with unchanged raw mass. General E1 operator/equation transfer is conditional on its explicit antecedents.
residual_original_scope: General unbounded mixed operators, weighted limits, strict locality/comparison, normalized actual-potential compactness, envelope continuity/orthogonality/both-sign outer differentiation and original all-E1 target characterization/attainment/every-solution uniqueness over nontrivial and nondiscrete fields remain unestablished.
